reviewed_against: 3GPP TS 23.401 sec 4.7.2 EPS bearer architecture and the S1/S5 bearer chain
3GPP TS 23.401 sec 5.3.2 initial attach and default bearer establishment
3GPP TS 23.401 sec 5.3.5 detach and bearer release
3GPP TS 29.274 sec 7.1 GTP-C tunnel identity: TEID, address and path peer
3GPP TS 29.274 sec 7.2 GTPv2-C tunnel management messages including Delete Session
3GPP TS 29.274 sec 8.8 EPS Bearer ID (EBI) information element
3GPP TS 29.281 sec 4.4 GTP-U TEID and receiving endpoint
3GPP TS 24.007 sec 11.2.3.1.5 EPS bearer identity coding

narrative_subject_requires: a published hop-local session context from the accepted session-identity analysis
the capture scope and interface class of that context
the allocation transaction reference and its accepted outcome
the member transaction references published for the context
no inferred global UE, subscriber or PDN-session identity
narrative_group_requires: an ESTABLISHED CROSS_INTERFACE_SESSION_IDENTITY link from the accepted identity analysis
both member contexts published in the same capture
a deterministic group reference derived from the capture and the sorted member context references
the group is a reporting label only and is never a global PDN session
release_narrative_requires: a release transaction reference published by the accepted identity or lifecycle analysis
the release outcome classified from the correlated response only
the release-to-session binding status kept separate from the outcome
the generation-closure status kept separate from both
exact request and confirmation frame anchors when published, null otherwise
generation_admission_requires: an ESTABLISHED release-to-session binding for the same capture and release transaction
a lifecycle subject carrying a proved generation boundary naming this release transaction
an ESTABLISHED generation-closure candidate in the accepted identity analysis for the same session context and release transaction
an ESTABLISHED session-to-generation link from that context to the candidate's bearer endpoint reference
exact equality of receiving endpoint role, address, TEID and reviewed interface type between the candidate and the lifecycle subject
an affirmatively complete closure-critical candidate set
generation_forbidden_evidence: an equal EPS bearer identity alone
a repeated advertisement interpreted as a new generation
a bridge-mediated relationship treated as a direct bearer closure
an S5/S8 Delete Session treated as closing an S1-U bearer without explicit source proof

temporal_rules.partition_basis: FRAME_LEVEL_EVENTS only when detailed GTP-U events resolve every counted packet
temporal_rules.aggregate_fallback: an aggregate stream count is published whole with temporal_placement_status TEMPORAL_PLACEMENT_NOT_ESTABLISHED and is never divided across windows
temporal_rules.partition_exclusivity: a G-PDU frame is counted in at most one partition of one release narrative
temporal_rules.pending_release_interval: an observation window between the request and confirmation frames; never evidence that forwarding stopped
temporal_rules.confirmation_frame: a control-plane confirmation anchor; never the forwarding-stop instant
temporal_rules.post_confirmation_traffic: an observation requiring interpretation; never packet loss, never delivery, never root cause
temporal_rules.frame_order_scope: frame ordering is valid only inside one capture file
temporal_rules.timestamp_use: observed metadata only; timestamp proximity never establishes identity
generation_attribution_requires: the stream's own capture equal to the narrative capture
an accepted stream association from the S1-U analysis
exactly one proved generation owner of the receiving endpoint
a lifecycle generation-scoped S1-U observation naming exactly that generation and exactly that stream
no other proved generation claiming the same stream
generation_attribution_forbidden: an equal EPS bearer identity alone
a SUPPORTED stream association treated as generation ownership without the lifecycle generation-scoped observation
attributing traffic observed in one capture to a generation proved in another
partition_proof_requires: the observed frame-level G-PDU count equal to the accepted aggregate count
the observed frame-level payload octets equal to the accepted aggregate payload octets
every counted frame owned by exactly one release narrative
temporal_rules.partition_incomplete: an unreconciled frame set keeps its observed subset positions with partition_scope OBSERVED_SUBSET and temporal_placement_status TEMPORAL_PLACEMENT_NOT_ESTABLISHED; the aggregate stays authoritative and no missing packet or octet is interpolated
temporal_rules.duplicate_ownership: when two release narratives claim the same G-PDU frame, both publish duplicate_frame_ownership, neither publishes a partition, and the frame is assigned to no release window

source_reference_validation: a published release frame anchor is re-checked against the supplied capture when detailed GTPv2-C events are provided
a missing or conflicting anchor publishes provenance_status INCONSISTENT and an unbound record
the source claim stays visible; the narrative never repairs the producer document
without detailed GTPv2-C events the provenance stays NOT_VALIDATED and a limitation is published
candidate_completeness_requires: for every material source collection: a present nonnegative declared count
the declared count equal to the published record array length
a present, valid and zero omitted count where the source publishes one
no exhaustive release or generation coverage while any collection is truncated or its metadata is invalid
no uniqueness inferred from the visible subset

the closure-critical collections (release session bindings, session-to-generation links, generation closure candidates, lifecycle subjects) are gated individually, not only through an aggregate status
no unique bearer-generation closure is promoted while a closure-critical collection is incomplete

forbidden_conclusions: a single SUCCESS or FAILURE verdict for a release
an accepted release response treated as the forwarding-stop instant
an observed G-PDU treated as proof of UE receipt or application reachability
an unresolved stream treated as packet loss or tunnel failure
a hop-local context merged into a global PDN session
an endpoint correspondence promoted to session identity
a first abnormal boundary or root cause selected by this capability
a network-function liability assigned from a release narrative
not_confirmed: a narrative subject is a hop-local control-plane grouping, not a subscriber or a PDN session
an accepted release outcome does not prove that user-plane forwarding stopped
a proved bearer-generation boundary does not forbid a later observed G-PDU
an observed G-PDU never proves UE delivery
an aggregate stream count carries no temporal placement
an unresolved stream is not packet loss and not a tunnel failure
the exact instant user-plane forwarding stopped is never proven by a release response
no subscriber identity, APN name or assigned PDN address is read or published
no first abnormal boundary, root cause or network-function blame is produced
